business_rules.name: Customer Region Mapping
business_rules.description: region_code mapped to a full region name via CASE statement.

business_rules.name: Customer Tier Classification
business_rules.description: Customer tier derived from lifetime_value thresholds.

business_rules.name: Tier-Based Discount
business_rules.description: Discount percentage applied based on customer_tier (PLATINUM/GOLD/SILVER/else).

business_rules.name: Order Aging Discount Exception
business_rules.description: Additional discount applied when order age exceeds 90 days.
business_rules.confidence_notes: Business justification for the 90-day / 2% values is not present in the source script; flagged for human review rather than assumed.

business_rules.name: Order Status Normalization
business_rules.description: Raw status codes normalized into CANCELLED/FULFILLED/IN_PROGRESS/UNKNOWN buckets.

business_rules.name: Active Customer Filter
business_rules.description: Only customers with active_flag = 'Y' are included.

business_rules.name: 2-Year Order Window
business_rules.description: Only orders within the last 24 months are processed.
business_rules.confidence_notes: No documented business reason found for the 24-month cutoff; flagged for human review.

business_rules.name: Customer Dimension SCD Type 1
business_rules.description: dim_customers refreshed via MERGE with overwrite semantics; no history retained.

dependencies: stg_orders depends on raw_orders, raw_order_items, stg_customers
